lines.text: Many learners say: I make my homework every night.
Better: I do my homework every night.
Homework goes with do, not make.

data.wrong: I make my homework every night.
data.right: I do my homework every night.
data.why: Homework goes with do, not make.

native.tip: On « fait » ses devoirs en français, mais en anglais : “do my homework”, pas “make”.
native.caption: Vous dites “I make my homework every night.” ? Pour les devoirs, l’anglais n’emploie pas “make”. Dites plutôt “I do my homework every night.” — écoutez Ama et répétez avec elle ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.
native.comment: Réponse : “does” — Les devoirs se disent avec “do”, pas avec “make”. Testez d’autres pièges avec un quiz gratuit : {link}

en.tip: Learners often say “make my homework”. In English, homework goes with “do”.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I make my homework every night.” With homework, English uses “do”. Say “I do my homework every night.” Listen to Ama and repeat with her! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
